thread.title: Apple's stock drop would cut the Dow's price by about 22 points - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Apple's stock drop would cut the Dow's price by about 22 points - MarketWatch
text:
Shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, +1.35% fell 1.9% in premarket trade Tuesday, and could be blamed for a chunk of the weakness in futures YMZ8, -0.38% for the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +1.46% in the aftermath of President Trump's comments about potential tariffs on iPhones . The stock's price decline ahead of the open would shave about 22 points off the Dow's price, while Dow futures are down 57 points. Meanwhile, United Technologies Corp.'s stock UTX, -0.82% rose 1.1% in premarket trade after the industrial conglomerate said it will separate into three companies , which would add about 9 points to the Dow's price.
